newsitem.title: USA: Anthem continues Acordia brokerage unit sale talks.
newsitem.headline: Anthem continues Acordia brokerage unit sale talks.

text.p: Anthem Insurance Cos Inc said Wednesday it is continuing discussions with an unnamed third-party financial buyer regarding the possible sale of the brokerage operations of Acordia Inc.
Last month, Acordia signed a definitive merger agreement with Acordia, under which Anthem would acquire Acordia stock for $40 a share.
Anthem said that, based on discussions to date, it is likely that if the transaction is completed, it would be for less than the prospective buyer's original indication of $335 million.

Anthem said the parties continue to have significant differences regarding terms, including the purchase price, Anthem said. It added that there can be no assurance that discussions will result in a transaction or any assurance about terms or timing.

Anthem, a mutual insurance company, said it also has extended its $40 a share cash tender offer for all shares of Acordia until midnight EDT July 9. As of July 1, Anthem said it received tenders of approximately 829,000 Acordia common shares.
